title: Xfinity app icon on a home screen
slide_intent: Test a symbol at a familiar app scale so viewers can distinguish it among unrelated icons.
strategic_value: The white X on purple can give Xfinity a compact point of recognition on a crowded phone.
demonstration: A cropped perspective phone places the Xfinity icon beside Calendar, Photos and Camera against a purple presentation field.
practical_value: Judge the mark inside its icon container and beside neighboring apps rather than only as an isolated large logo.

content_islands.name: Phone crop
content_islands.spec: Enlarge the upper corner of the phone and angle it across the lower part of the canvas.

content_islands.name: App neighborhood
content_islands.spec: Keep the Xfinity icon and its label beside familiar neighboring icons so their relative scale remains visible.

content_islands.name: Purple field
content_islands.spec: Use the purple outer field to frame the device and echo the Xfinity icon.

ingredient.name: X app icon
ingredient.role: Identify the service in a small app container.
ingredient.application: Place the white X inside the purple rounded-square icon and retain its app label.
ingredient.scope: This displayed home-screen example; the case study does not specify clear space or minimum pixel dimensions.

reference_purposes.Expression: A white X and purple rounded square form the compact visual signature.
reference_purposes.Application: The artwork tests that signature beside other apps on a phone home screen.
